tasks.short: Research potential donors, investors and donor markets.

steps.what: Retrieve permitted donor records, recorded interests and actual donation history for the research scope
Research goals, reported net worth estimates, charitable donation history and donor-market facts in permitted source documents
inputs: selected public reports and permitted research documents
outputs: source-linked extracted facts with dates, identity qualifiers and unknowns

loop.purpose: Extract explicit donor and market facts from selected text
loop.input: Manager-selected permitted documents and subject identifiers
loop.output: Candidate fact entries with verbatim supporting passages and dates
loop.check: Manager verifies identity, attribution, date, uncertainty and each fact's meaning against the original
loop.stop: Unclear identity or unsupported claim stays unknown; one correction attempt then manual extraction
loop.why_not_simpler: Native CRM fields and exact search cover existing facts; irregular narrative reports need reading, but no autonomous web research or wealth inference is needed.

steps.what: Resolve identity conflicts and assess research relevance without turning reported estimates into verified personal wealth
inputs: source-linked extracted facts with dates, identity qualifiers and unknowns

steps.what: Prepare the research brief using verified fact fields and source links around the manager's conclusions
inputs: source-linked extracted facts with dates, identity qualifiers and unknowns

steps.what: Approve the final brief, permitted fields, access and donor-record association
Commit the approved research brief to the restricted internal donor research record

tasks.design: Test native {CRM} donor history views and source fields first; a bounded extraction loop reads only manager-selected permitted reports in {DOCS}. The manager counts source selection, identity checking and claim-fidelity review, then a native brief template reuses verified fields around human conclusions. Only the exact approved brief is committed internally; edits invalidate approval, unsupported wealth estimates remain attributed or unknown, and no outreach or inferred sensitive traits are produced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Irregular reports and donor records require repeated reading and copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CRM views and bounded source-linked extraction can reduce preparation without autonomous prospecting.
tasks.still_hard: Identity ambiguity, stale estimates and relevance to actual donor goals.
tasks.human_edge: Judge evidence quality and appropriate use of personal research.

ambition.what: Improve traceability of current donor research.

tasks.altitude: Research support with retained decisions about relevance and use.

reach.learn: Distinguish recorded preferences from unverified public estimates.

evidence.claim: Native CRM views and bounded language-model extraction can assist source-linked research; this is a capability hypothesis, not a fundraising productivity case.

assumptions: All shares are provisional, not measured.

Normal gift processing produces donor ID, date, amount and fund entries; s1 includes gaps. The manager selects permitted reports and captures subject identifiers and source dates within s2; unclear values are read manually.
All extracted claims are checked in retained s2 time. No source retrieval or checking work is transferred to other roles.
Only data permitted for the stated research purpose enter the chosen environment; otherwise extraction stays manual.
unknowns: Permitted research fields, source access and local retention policy.
research_questions: Does extraction reduce reading effort after identity and claim checks?

already_counted.description: Source reading and claim verification and final brief review.

incremental.description: Check extraction errors, source freshness and research-field retention.

approvals.approved_version: approved donor research version with permitted fields, identity, sources and access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Ten internal lookup, nine extraction, 4.5 brief assembly and five filing hours saved, less three upkeep. Low case assumes checks remove all preparation gain while upkeep remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write releases and media kits and maintain web pages.

steps.what: Gather verified campaign facts, approved impact figures, authorized quotes, media assets and current page content
inputs: existing campaign records and permission records

steps.what: Write interesting press releases and media-kit narratives from the verified fundraising facts

loop.purpose: Draft audience-appropriate release and media-kit prose
loop.input: Verified source pack, audience and required message
loop.check: Manager checks meaning, context, attribution and permission for each claim and quote
loop.stop: Unsupported claim is removed; two edits at most before manual authorship
loop.why_not_simpler: Native boilerplate handles standard sections; the campaign-specific story still needs writing.

steps.what: Assemble the media kit using native layouts, selected authorized images, factual tables and contact details
outputs: complete proposed release and media kit

steps.what: Develop or update the company web page draft using native content blocks and verified release material
inputs: complete proposed release and media kit
outputs: final proposed release, kit, page preview and media recipient list

steps.what: Approve the complete final release, media kit, page preview, permissions and named distribution recipients
inputs: final proposed release, kit, page preview and media recipient list

steps.what: Publish the approved page version to the public company website
Send the approved release and media kit to the approved external media recipients

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} boilerplate and {CMS} content blocks first, with a bounded prose loop for the campaign-specific release and kit narrative. The manager gathers actual facts and permissions, checks the drafted meaning, assembles assets and reviews the complete page preview before separate public publishing and {EMAIL} distribution actions. Any text, asset, recipient or page-target change voids approval; no model creates quotes, impact figures or permissions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Campaign narratives and factual material are reformatted across releases, kits and pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layouts and bounded drafting can reuse one verified source pack.
tasks.still_hard: Communicating impact accurately and deciding what the audience needs.
tasks.human_edge: Editorial judgement and relationships with the people represented in the story.

ambition.what: Maintain the current communications channels with less repeated preparation.

tasks.altitude: The manager keeps editorial control and external publishing authority.

reach.learn: Reuse verified claims and exact asset permissions across formats.

evidence.claim: HubSpot offers branded content and campaign content assistance; this supports drafting capability, not a measured fundraising result.

assumptions: s1 captures or verifies campaign fact, source date, authorized quote, asset rights and audience; managers obtain missing facts manually there. Existing campaign records are produced in normal program work.
This case maintains a public web page; an intranet-only publication uses internal authority instead.
s2 includes claim-fidelity checking and edits; s5 is an additional final package approval within the manager's delegated publication authority.
unknowns: Current CMS reusable block coverage and required organizational publication sign-off.
research_questions: Does draft preparation save time after factual and editorial review?

already_counted.description: Draft claim checking and final package approval.

incremental.description: Maintain fact-pack rules, templates and drafting error checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved communications package version including exact page preview, assets and public target
approved communications package version including final release, kit and media recipient list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Fourteen narrative, six kit assembly, 7.5 page preparation and ten publishing/sending hours saved, less three upkeep. Low case assumes existing native templates and full redrafting remove all preparation benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve existing fundraising policies, approved governance requirements and actual program process evidence
outputs: linked policy evidence and unresolved requirements

steps.what: Formulate fundraising program policy choices, responsibilities and exception procedures after consulting affected staff
inputs: linked policy evidence and unresolved requirements
outputs: manager's explicit policy decisions and procedure actions

steps.what: Write the fundraising policy and procedure draft from the manager's chosen actions, responsibilities and controls
inputs: manager's explicit policy decisions and procedure actions
linked policy evidence and unresolved requirements
outputs: complete proposed fundraising policy and procedure

loop.purpose: Express decided policies and procedure actions clearly
loop.input: Manager-authored choices, action sequence, control owners and controlled references
loop.output: Draft policy with traceable responsibilities and exceptions
loop.check: Manager checks that every obligation and procedure action matches decisions and source intent, not just names or dates
loop.stop: Any invented control or unresolved legal requirement returns to the manager; two drafting passes maximum
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates supply structure, but new procedure explanations require prose.

steps.what: Review practical and governance meaning and approve the complete final policy and effective version
inputs: complete proposed fundraising policy and procedure

steps.what: Commit the approved policy and procedure to the controlled internal policy library

tasks.design: Configure controlled reference views and native policy templates in {DOCS}, linked to relevant {CRM} process evidence. The manager formulates the actual policy and action sequence; a bounded loop helps write them, with retained checks of obligation and procedure meaning before final approval. A separate action commits the exact approved effective version, edits cancel approval, and the loop neither determines legal requirements nor silently changes authority or exceptions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy drafting repeats reference collection and prose preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and bounded prose drafting can express explicit human decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing workable controls and resolving governance and operational conflicts.
tasks.human_edge: Own the policy's consequences and judge whether staff can follow it.

ambition.what: Prepare current fundraising policies with clearer traceability.

tasks.altitude: The manager retains policy choices and delegated sign-off.

reach.learn: Trace each obligation to an approved requirement or explicit management decision.

evidence.claim: Language models can assist prose drafting from explicit decisions, while native policy libraries provide version control; task-specific effectiveness remains unmeasured.

assumptions: s1 includes missing-reference investigation. s2 counts consultation and captures each chosen action, owner, exception and control; no prepared procedure is assumed.
This scope is within the manager's delegated policy authority. Additional governance approvals, where required, must be separately counted before library release.
No legal advice is generated by the tool.
unknowns: Required governance approvals and existing native policy template coverage.
research_questions: How often do draft obligations differ from the manager's intended policy?

already_counted.description: Draft meaning checks and complete final policy review.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled source links and drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: approved fundraising policy version including obligations, effective date and library target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: eight reference and nine drafting hours saved less two upkeep. Low: no draft or lookup improvement after checks, with upkeep retained. Same-library saving is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign, supervise and review fundraising staff activities.

steps.what: Review current fundraising activity status, commitments and workload in native project views
Assign fundraising activities after judging priorities, capability and workload with staff
Prepare exact staff assignment entries and individual instruction messages with native task fields
Approve the complete assignments, deadlines and staff message recipients
Commit the approved staff assignments to the internal project board
Send each approved instruction message to the assigned internal staff member
Supervise fundraising staff through observation, coaching and resolving activity problems
Review staff activities and discuss quality, progress and improvement needs
Write the actual review conclusions and support actions in a restricted supervisory note
Approve the final supervisory note and restricted record destination
Commit the approved supervisory note to the restricted internal management record

tasks.design: Configure native workload views, assignment fields and separately gated commitment and internal {CHAT} notifications in {PROJECT}, using existing {CRM} activity links. The manager decides assignments, coaches and reviews people; later supervisory notes in {DOCS} are authored and approved only after actual work and review occur, then separately committed. Changes void the relevant approval; no model ranks staff, infers performance or writes evaluations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assignment details are copied across boards and messages while supervision remains relational work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project views and approved task notifications reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Fair assignments, coaching and judging actual work quality.
tasks.human_edge: Understand staff circumstances and provide accountable feedback.

ambition.what: Reduce assignment administration around existing supervision.

tasks.altitude: The manager retains all staffing and performance decisions.

reach.learn: Reuse normal task status instead of preparing a separate management report.

evidence.claim: Native project tools can present task status, reuse assignment fields and notify staff after approval.

assumptions: Staff maintain task ID, status and commitment in normal work; s1 includes manual clarification where missing. The manager captures owner, action and deadline in s3 and actual review conclusions in s9.
No new status-entry requirement, staff scoring or monitoring system is introduced.
Assignments and messages precede work; supervisory notes follow actual work and review.
unknowns: How much assignment copying remains in the current project setup.
research_questions: Can native views remove separate updates without changing staff reporting effort?

already_counted.description: Assignment approval and later supervisory note writing and approval.

incremental.description: Maintain assignment fields, message routing and restricted-note access.

approvals.approved_version: approved assignment package version including staff owners, actions, deadlines and board target
approved assignment package version including exact instructions and internal recipients
approved supervisory note version including actual review conclusions and restricted destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four lookup, two assignment preparation and three real message-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing native workflow leaves just enough preparation benefit to cover upkeep. All same-record saves retain human time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Fundraising management with source-linked research and communications, and human donor and staff judgement.
reach: Communications, donor relationship and compliance colleagues share verified artifacts.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated research and content preparation while retaining responsibility for donor evidence, public claims and staff decisions.
